data_functions.name: select_refund_for_cancel
data_functions.description: 每个Variant在QA退款库查询当前真实退款单，按目标状态选取订单，并复用已有非空取消原因；缺少候选即DATA失败。

statement.value: SELECT refund_serial_no, refund_state, cancel_reason FROM saas_refund_order WHERE is_delete = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 500

data_functions.name: prepare_audited_refund
data_functions.description: QA缺少审核通过订单时，从当前待申请退款中准备一条审核通过记录，再读取真实候选；只改变一行并保留其他订单。

statement.value: UPDATE saas_refund_order SET refund_state = ? WHERE refund_state = ? AND is_delete = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT refund_serial_no, refund_state, cancel_reason FROM saas_refund_order WHERE is_delete = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 500
